plan_review.notes: Alt A second scheduler rejected: would duplicate route/budget authority. Alt B whole-BT utility selector rejected: tactical safety ordering remains valid. Alt C scenario-only scorer rejected: shared deterministic portfolio contract is needed, but v1 remains bounded to existing Floor 1 graph producers plus Floor 2 settlement candidate. Alt D extend current planner adopted: add utility/portfolio semantics to the exact planner rather than a competing DSL. Resolutions: explicit AI strategic affinity config; preserve optional bundle verdicts; settlement router retains latch/cooldown/fingerprint ownership and emits a candidate; cover every decision-mode consumer; separate portfolio-choice invalidation from route feasibility; explicit v1 floor scope; explicit committed-active-objective state with completion/invalidity release.
